restore.description: Archived managed sessions (Codex, and since revision 17 Claude/Gemini).

conversation_created_at.description: Native conversation timestamp when recorded; never filesystem mtime.

history_file_bytes.description: Bytes in the observed saved rollout, excluding shared account databases.

active_since.description: Unix seconds the live session became active (revision 17 for Claude and Gemini): the verified provider process or attachment start, never conversation age and never a pre-started bg-spare process; null when saved or when no honest source exists.

last_accessed.description: Unix seconds of the last observed access when known (Codex); null for Claude and Gemini, which expose no access source.

resume_block_reason.description: Observed resume gate; unfinished_history is an explicit-confirmation warning. Consumers tolerate future codes.

directory.description: Positively observed working directory; null when the source cannot currently be observed.

discovery_warnings.description: Discovery limitations, including incomplete optional native enrichment. Does not establish runtime readiness.

previous_conversation_ids.description: Native conversations this entry continued from (verified continued-in markers), oldest first.

display_name.description: Revision 11: optional display name; id/name/home never change on rename.

auth_failed.description: Revision 18: Gemini only. True while the last observed recognizable authentication failure stands (credentials present but rejected); cleared by a later successful run or login.

auth_failure_reason.description: Revision 18: fixed CODE: text for the failure, never raw provider output.

auth_failure_observed_at.description: Revision 18: Unix seconds of the failure.

auth_mode.description: Revision 21: Gemini authentication mode (the account's security.auth.selectedType); null for other providers.

api_key_present.description: Revision 21: Gemini only. Whether a private API key file is stored (stat only; the key is never exposed); null for other providers.

bypass_warning.description: Revision 22: Claude only. Whether Claude Code skips its bypass-permissions (YOLO) startup warning (settings.json skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt is true: skip; absent or false: show).

bypass_warning_value.description: Revision 22: Claude only. The raw stored boolean; null when the key is absent.

bypass_warning_setting.description: Revision 22: Claude only. The settings.json key.

hosted.description: Revision 16, Claude accounts only: start a Sessionsation-hosted (stream-json) session whose pane shows the viewer.

permissions.description: Revision 19: launch permissions for this start; omitted uses the launch_permissions setting (built-in default yolo).

created_at.description: Immutable Unix admission time for new records; absent/null means legacy creation time is unknown. Do not substitute updated_at.

permissions.description: Revision 19: launch permissions for this start; omitted uses the launch_permissions setting (built-in default yolo).

LaunchPermissions.description: Revision 19: yolo = Codex approval never + sandbox danger-full-access, Claude --dangerously-skip-permissions, Gemini --approval-mode yolo; default = the provider's own configuration (Codex resumes keep recorded permissions).

created_at.description: Immutable Unix admission time for new records; absent/null means legacy creation time is unknown. Do not substitute updated_at.
Immutable Unix admission time for new records; absent/null means legacy creation time is unknown. Do not substitute updated_at.

external_home.description: Claude adopted config directory; never modified or deleted.

deletes_local_credentials.description: true except for an adopted Claude config directory, which is left in place.

provider.description: Revision 17 adds claude and gemini (moved native files, compression none).

previous_conversation_ids.description: Revision 17, native providers: lineage conversations archived with this entry.

space_id.description: Requested Space, or the Space this operation created (null only before a new Space is created).

new_space.description: Label of the Space requested with --new-space, else null.

created_space_id.description: Id of the Space this operation created, journaled before ownership is rebound.

ClaudeHeadlessRequest.description: Revision 11 (Gemini added in revision 13): api send for provider claude or gemini. mode resume continues a stopped session; mode new starts one.

ClaudeHeadlessReceipt.description: Revision 11: durable receipt of a Claude headless delivery (api send/receipt).

AccountLoginPlan.description: Revision 11: account add claude:NAME and account login claude:NAME return the same login plan.

AccountRefresh.description: Revision 11: api account refresh claude:NAME probes claude auth status immediately.

AccountRename.description: Revision 11: api account rename ID --display-name X | --clear.

completion_input_item_id.description: Revision 18: the same input's id in the finished turn when Codex renumbered legacy item-N ids at turn end; steer_input_item_id keeps the in-progress id.

ClaudeSteerRequest.description: Revision 16: api send mode submit|queue|steer addressed to a Claude session (hosted worker or opted-in live session). Revision 17 adds delivery: auto (default: hosted, else terminal_input for submit/steer on a verified HERDR pane, else peer_message), or one path explicitly. Revision 17: the same request addresses a Gemini session (submit, queue or steer as terminal_input; delivery auto or terminal_input).

delivery.description: Revision 17. A path that does not apply is refused (DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE, TERMINAL_NOT_ATTACHED, LIVE_STEERING_DISABLED, ...).

ClaudeSteerReceipt.description: Revision 16: durable receipt of a Claude submit/queue/steer. hosted_stream_json correlates by command uuid and needs both the turn's result and the input's terminal command_lifecycle: completed_* only after 'completed'; an input whose consuming turn was cut ('cancelled' after 'started', even after a success result) ends interrupted with a non-final reply. peer_message correlates only by a transcript anchor. Revision 17 terminal_input (typed into the session's HERDR pane as the user's own input) correlates only by the human transcript record (user, or queued_command with origin human) that carries exactly the typed text after the submit; without it a submit is delivery_unknown (TERMINAL_INPUT_UNCONFIRMED) and is never re-sent. Revision 17 also uses this shape for Gemini CLI sessions (provider gemini, delivery_semantics terminal_input only, plus gemini_input; see GeminiSteerReceipt).

priority.description: submit next, queue later, steer next. Sessionsation never sends now (Claude Code cancels the running turn for it); now appears only on records written by pre-release revision-16 builds.

record_type.description: steering_update: Gemini user record carrying a user steering update (with the next tool response, or alone after the turn).

ClaudeSteerSemantics.description: Revision 16: what a Claude steer does to a running turn (claude_input_delivery.steer and the session row's input_delivery.steer, null when the session takes no input). A steer never interrupts: Claude Code folds a priority-next input into the running turn at its next tool round, or runs it as the next turn when the turn ends without one. steering.interrupt:true (hosted only) cancels the running turn first; that turn's inputs end interrupted. Revision 17: terminal_input rows report interrupt_option null (typed input never sends Esc or Ctrl+C).

ClaudeTerminalInput.description: Revision 17: terminal_input part of a ClaudeSteerReceipt. The user's draft text is never included; only whether it existed, its length and whether its restore was verified on screen.

escaped_prefix.description: A leading / ! # or ? was typed as \\/ \\! \\# \\? so it stays plain text.

text_normalized.description: CRLF or surrounding whitespace was removed before typing.

left_in_input.description: What the input box held when the procedure ended after the clear: draft (restored and verified), empty, message (the delivered text), other or unknown (screen unreadable). null when nothing was cleared. Anything but draft keeps the draft in the private journal.

left_chars.description: Characters in the input box when left_in_input was recorded (null when unknown).

NativeConversationArchive.description: Revision 17: capabilities.conversation_archive.native. Claude and Gemini archive/restore/delete move the exact-id files of one catalog entry's conversations (current and previous_conversation_ids); credentials are never read or touched. Per-session availability is capabilities.archive|delete|restore with capability_reasons.

GeminiSteerReceipt.description: Revision 17: receipt of a Gemini submit/queue/steer (typed input into the session's HERDR pane).

GeminiTerminalInput.description: Revision 17: gemini_input part of a Gemini receipt. What Enter did depends on whether a turn was running and on the session's experimental.modelSteering. outcome and steering come only from the transcript record; screen_evidence only from the screen right after Enter.

batched.description: The anchoring user record carries more than this text: queued messages joined into one prompt, or a prompt Gemini expanded.

GeminiSteerSemantics.description: Revision 17: what a Gemini steer does (capabilities.gemini_input_delivery.steer and a Gemini row's input_delivery.steer). Agent-DM shows it as Steer with the caveat.

GeminiTerminalInputDelivery.description: Revision 17: capabilities.gemini_input_delivery (and the gemini provider's input_delivery).

GeminiLiveSteering.description: Revision 17: api account live-steering gemini:NAME [--enable|--disable]. Sets or removes experimental.modelSteering in GEMINI_CLI_HOME/.gemini/settings.json (only that key; atomic replace; mode kept; symlinks refused). Running sessions read it at startup, so restart_required is true when it changed while sessions ran.
